title: Tomato and soft-vegetable post-harvest handling guide
context: Soft produce like tomatoes bruises and rots in transport and storage; simple handling changes cut loss substantially.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to harvesting, sorting, packing, and short-term storage of tomatoes and similar soft vegetables to reduce loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers harvest timing, gentle handling, sorting/grading, packing, and cool storage basics
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
